description: Defines the TransportParameters struct and related classes for QUIC's transport layer, including serialization, parsing, and validation functions, used during TLS handshake.

classes.name: TransportParameters
classes.description: Contains parameters exchanged during the QUIC TLS handshake, with methods for validation, serialization, and logging.

classes.name: IntegerParameter
classes.description: Represents a variable-length integer transport parameter with validation and serialization methods.

classes.name: PreferredAddress
classes.description: Holds preferred server address information for transport parameter exchange.

classes.name: LegacyVersionInformation
classes.description: Represents Google QUIC downgrade prevention info, to be deprecated.

classes.name: VersionInformation
classes.description: Contains version info for downgrade prevention and version negotiation.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Sets the value of a transport parameter.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the current value of a transport parameter.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the transport parameter value.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Serializes the parameter into a buffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Deserializes the parameter from a buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the parameter.

methods.name: PreferredAddress
methods.description: Constructs a preferred address object.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of PreferredAddress objects.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality of PreferredAddress objects.

methods.name: LegacyVersionInformation
methods.description: Constructs a legacy version info object.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of LegacyVersionInformation objects.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality of LegacyVersionInformation objects.

methods.name: VersionInformation
methods.description: Constructs a version info object.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of VersionInformation objects.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality of VersionInformation objects.

methods.name: AreValid
methods.description: Validates the entire set of transport parameters.

methods.name: SerializeTransportParameters
methods.description: Serializes transport parameters into a byte vector for TLS extension.

methods.name: ParseTransportParameters
methods.description: Parses transport parameters from TLS extension bytes.

methods.name: SerializeTransportParametersForTicket
methods.description: Serializes parameters and application data for early data tickets.

methods.name: DegreaseTransportParameters
methods.description: Removes reserved values from parameters for reliable comparison.
